meta.name: The Dark Lighthouse
meta.description: A one-evening adventure for 3–5 level-1 heroes. The lighthouse above the fishing village has gone dark, and the boats are due home by nightfall.
meta.credits: Original text and map. Monsters and items from the System Reference Document 5.1 (CC-BY-4.0).

story.title: The Dark Lighthouse
readAloud: The lighthouse above Gullhaven has gone dark. Old Marla, its keeper, has not been seen since yesterday, and the fishing boats are due home at nightfall.
The village elder presses a purse into your hands: thirty silver now, more when the lamp burns again. The only way up, she says, is through the shore cave beneath the cliff.

story.title: DM: how this evening runs
story.dmNotes: Five rooms, about 1–2 hours. Goblins led by a bugbear named Grak have taken the lighthouse to wreck the boats on the rocks and loot them. Marla is tied up in the lamp room. Fights get harder: rats (easy), the guard post (medium), Grak and his wolf (hard). The stair hall has a falling-stones trap. The lamp-room door is locked: the three lanterns beside it must be lit in the order the guard-post rhyme gives (red, green, gold). When the players do that, unlock the door (click it). If they're stuck, a successful DC 12 Intelligence (Investigation) check on the rhyme gives the order.

story.title: 1. Shore cave
readAloud: Cold sea air pushes into a low cave. Wet sand gives way to a stone step, and beyond it you hear water slapping against wood.
story.dmNotes: Start here. Nothing hostile. A DC 10 Wisdom (Survival) check spots small goblin footprints heading east.

story.title: 2. Flooded store
readAloud: Barrels float in knee-deep water. Something large and furred slides between them, then another, then a third.
story.dmNotes: Three giant rats (easy). The water is difficult terrain. Crates in the corner hold 12 gp and a lantern.

story.title: 3. Guard post
readAloud: Torches light a table covered in dice and stolen bread. A painted rhyme runs along the wall: 'Red for the sunset, green for the sea, gold for the morning — light them for me.'
story.dmNotes: A hobgoblin and a goblin (medium) are playing dice. If the heroes sneak in (Stealth vs passive Perception 10), they get a surprise round. The rhyme is the clue to the lamp-room door.

story.title: 4. Stair hall
readAloud: A spiral stair climbs into the dark. Halfway along the hall the flagstones look newer than the rest.
story.dmNotes: Falling stones trap across the hall (row 9): DEX save DC 12 for half of 2d6. A hero with passive Perception 13 or more notices it and it does not spring. They can climb around it with a DC 10 Strength (Athletics) check.

story.title: 5. Lamp room
readAloud: Three unlit lanterns — red, green and gold — hang beside an iron door. Behind it, someone is shouting for help, and something growls.
story.dmNotes: The door is locked until the lanterns are lit red, green, gold. Inside: Grak the bugbear and his wolf (hard). Marla is tied to the great lamp. Treasure: 40 gp, one potion of healing per hero, and Marla's cloak of protection as thanks. Relighting the lamp ends the adventure; award the XP from the fights.

items.name: Cloak of Protection
items.description: While wearing it you gain +1 to AC and saving throws (requires attunement).
